crossRefs.note: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter, but of the Spirit. For the letter kills…
Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of…
of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of…
To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from…
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly…
In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.
Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in…
You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.

translations.web: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
translations.bsb: Therefore, since God in His mercy has given us this ministry, we do not lose heart.
translations.kjv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
translations.asv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we faint not:
